steps.title: Celestriad towers
steps.rule: Soak your tower for this set: the tower of your element, or with no element the second tower of the doubled element. Stand beside your partner, one on each side of it.

OffTank.rule: Read the strat's PlaceAtTower: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: TowerElementOrder).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Read the strat's PlaceAtTower: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: DoubleElement).

CasterDps.rule: Read the strat's PlaceAtTower: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: DoubleElement).

steps.title: Catastrophic Choice
steps.rule: Catastrophic Choice: stay in your tower and take the safe half. Green (Aero) means step toward the boss, brown (Earth) means step away from it.
